deviations_from_adr: ADR-committed orphan-fix was 'PDP-check BEFORE insertFile, OR throw/ROLLBACK in addVersion on deny'. Implemented the FORMER (pre-check) after live-proof showed the latter is INSUFFICIENT: PgFileStore.insertFile/insertVersion/setCurrentVersion each run on their OWN pooled connection (this.pool.query) OUTSIDE the withTenantTx client, so they autocommit and the tx ROLLBACK cannot undo the insertFile row. This is within the ADR's stated option set (chose option a of the two it listed), not a divergence.

IN-SCOPE ADDITION surfaced by live-proof (documented in ADR §2.1 / build commit): the file READ resolver was wired with the raw org-only SEED_ORACLE, which cannot resolve the RESOURCE_ROOT default-open read grant every staff member holds (migration 124 / T-0619) -> a plain reader's download 403'd (file-read gave LESS than record-read). Fixed by building the SAME composite resource-ancestry oracle (makeResourceAncestryOracle) record-read uses, per-call, keyed on the handle tenant. This is required by the task's 'download works' + 'no less than record read' + 'do not break PDP' clauses.
friction_events: FE-T0620-1: worktree had no node_modules (known grab: npm install after merge / fresh worktree). Ran npm install --maxsockets=3 (root) before build; build then green.

FE-T0620-2: my first DB test wired grantsPool as choros_app (appUrl) which enforces RLS on PgFileStore.insertFile -> 500 RLS-policy-violation, because insertFile uses its own pool connection with no tenant GUC. Production DATABASE_URL = choros_migrator (BYPASSRLS), which is exactly why the orphan-commit bug reproduces in prod. Switched the test grantsPool to migratorUrl() to mirror production faithfully; tenant isolation on this path is then enforced by the explicit tenant_id params + the resolver tenant-gate (both under test), not RLS.

FE-T0620-3: initial DB-test read-grant seed used the wrong sentinel (nodeId all-zeros / nodeLevel 'root' / facet {fields:[]}) and omitted confirmed_by -> reader download 403. Fixed to the EXACT migration-124 grant shape: scope {resource, nodeLevel 'application', nodeId '00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000r0'}, resource_facet NULL, confirmed_by NON-NULL (getGrantsForSubject step 3 / T-0397 filters NULL-confirmed grants out).

FE-T0620-4: router.dispatch swallows non-HttpError into an opaque 500 envelope; added a temporary CHOROS_DEBUG_500 console.error to surface the RLS root cause, then FULLY reverted it (git diff src/http/router.ts is empty).
